title: [Bug] Multiple Claude Code instances fail after update to 2.0.60
body:
**Bug Description**
hey. after updating to 2.0.60, i can no longer run multiple instances of CC in the cursor terminals.

**Environment Info**

- Terminal: cursor

top_comments.body: My WSL with Ubuntu can't even handle more than 1 instance ... but downgrading to 2.58 did not help either so it must be something server-side.

top_comments.body: Same issue on VS Code terminals. Used to run 3/4 terminals happily until it did the weird endless-scrolling thing. Now it crashes soon as I go above 1 instance. Opus 4.5.
